0022600006.text: The Cavaliers open their 2026-27 season at Philadelphia, where the 76ers are 1-0 after their first game and sit 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East. Cleveland won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 115-101 win in Cleveland in their most recent meeting, and this season's series has no games yet. Cleveland is missing Khalifa Diop (knee) and Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back), and Jarrett Allen (knee) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (back), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps), with Dean Wade (ankle sprain) day-to-day and a game-time decision.
